# Write the background

Read `.research/project_telos.md`, relevant verified literature notes and bibliographies, the existing manuscript, and target venue guidance.

Build a concise argument from field context to the specific gap, then state how the project addresses it. Synthesize evidence across sources rather than listing papers. Make the gap and study contribution explicit without claiming novelty or importance beyond the evidence.

Use only verified citations. Preserve uncertainty, disagreements, population and methodological limits, and distinguish published evidence from project rationale. Do not target a fixed citation count or word count unless the venue specifies one.

Update `manuscript/background.md` when requested and identify unsupported claims or literature gaps separately from the draft.
